name: ThriveKid
tagline: Parent PWA to track a child's growth, sleep, feeding and milestones

children.title: React 19 frontend
children.summary: TypeScript SPA where parents log daily stuff, see charts and pull reports for each child.
children.detail: Vite + Tailwind build, React Router 7 for 50+ routes, Chart.js for graphs, Axios for API calls, lucide icons and toast messages.

children.title: Protected routing
children.summary: Public pages (login, signup, privacy) and everything else wrapped in a ProtectedRoute plus shared Layout.
children.detail: Child-scoped routes like /children/:childId/reports/sleep and /children/:childId/vaccinations keep each view tied to one child. A 404 catch-all came out of the code review.

children.title: Auth context
children.summary: React context holding the signed-in user and tokens, with login, register and logout calls.
children.detail: Login and register store the access token, refresh token and user. Logout calls /auth/logout so the refresh token is revoked server side, then clears everything.

children.title: Dashboard
children.summary: Home screen with stat cards, quick actions, today's info, recent activity and upcoming reminders.
children.detail: Was 865 lines before the code review; split into dashboard/* components and a useDashboardData hook.

children.title: Per-child reports
children.summary: Report pages for growth, sleep, feeding, milestones, medical, monthly and check-in trends.
children.detail: Check-in summary counts good / okay / rough for sleep, feeding and day quality and is laid out for printing.

children.title: Activity and sleep charts
children.summary: Chart.js graphs for sleep patterns and activity alongside the growth charts.

children.title: Badges and insights
children.summary: Badge progress for logging streaks and auto-generated insights from daily check-ins.
children.detail: Badges compute progress toward each unlock and surface the next few to chase. Insights scan recent check-ins for patterns.

children.title: Photos and media
children.summary: Photo upload and gallery for milestones and memories.

children.title: Light / dark theme
children.summary: Theme context that follows the system color scheme by default.

children.title: PWA layer
children.summary: Installable app with a service worker, offline handling and local reminder notifications.

children.title: Service worker caching
children.summary: Precaches the app shell, serves pages network-first with cache fallback, never caches API calls.
children.detail: Versioned cache cleans out old caches on activate. API requests always go to the network; offline they get a JSON 503. Navigation falls back to cached index.html.

children.title: Install prompt
children.summary: Catches beforeinstallprompt and shows an install banner; detects when it's already running standalone.

children.title: Web app manifest
children.summary: Standalone display mode, app icons and home-screen shortcuts.

children.title: Online / offline events
children.summary: Fires app-online and app-offline events so the UI can react when the connection drops.

children.title: Reminder notifications
children.summary: Hook polls reminders every 60 seconds and fires a browser notification when one comes due.
children.detail: Uses the browser Notification API, so it works while the app is open. True push while closed is on the roadmap.

children.title: ThriveKid.Api.Rest
children.summary: ASP.NET Core 8 Web API layer: controllers, request/response resources and the HTTP pipeline.

children.title: 15 REST controllers
children.summary: One controller per feature plus auth, users and file upload, all behind JWT except auth.

children.title: Resources + validators
children.summary: ForCreate / ForUpdate / Response DTOs per feature, each with a FluentValidation validator.
children.detail: Validation runs twice: API validators check the request shape and MaxLength limits, domain validators in ThriveKid.App check business rules. Assembly scanning registers them all.

children.title: ProblemDetails errors
children.summary: Global exception handler returns RFC 7807 ProblemDetails with a trace id and a generic message.

children.title: FeatureRegistration DI
children.summary: Each feature's service + storage pair is wired in one method, so adding a feature is one line.

children.title: File upload
children.summary: Image and video upload up to 50MB with extension checks and magic-byte signature checks.
children.detail: Reads the first bytes of each file and matches JPEG, PNG, GIF, WEBP, MP4/MOV, AVI and WEBM/MKV signatures. Delete rejects '..' paths and requires an /uploads/ prefix.

children.title: Health checks
children.summary: /health and /health/ready endpoints with an EF Core database check.

children.title: ThriveKid.App feature modules
children.summary: Application layer with domain models living inside each feature folder: Domain, Services, Storage interface, Validators.
children.detail: Every feature follows the same build order: domain model, storage interface, EF config, storage impl, validator, service, DTOs, controller, DI. Services enforce ownership by checking UserId on every read and write.

children.title: Daily tracking modules
children.summary: The modules parents use day to day to log what's happening.

children.title: FeedingLogs
children.summary: Log breastmilk, formula and solids with meal type, time and notes.

children.title: SleepLogs
children.summary: Start and end times with a computed sleep duration and end-after-start validation.

children.title: GrowthLogs
children.summary: Height and weight entries per child that feed the WHO growth charts.

children.title: Milestones
children.summary: Developmental wins with dates and an optional photo.

children.title: DailyCheckIn
children.summary: Quick good / okay / rough check-ins for sleep, feeding and the day, stored with the local date.
children.detail: Saves LocalDate (YYYY-MM-DD) plus the IANA time zone used, so 'today' means the parent's today, not UTC. Values are whitelist-validated.

children.title: MedicalRecords + vaccines
children.summary: Doctor visits and vaccination records, with a built-in CDC/WHO vaccine schedule by age.
children.detail: Schedule entries carry recommended age in months, dose number and a give-by window.

children.title: Planning and account modules
children.summary: Child profiles, goals, reminders, toy ideas, family budgeting and user accounts.

children.title: Child
children.summary: Child profiles with automatic age-in-months; the template every other module copies.

children.title: LearningGoals
children.summary: Age-appropriate goals with completion tracking; a completed date is required only once done.

children.title: Reminders
children.summary: Tasks with due dates, repeat rules and a per-reminder time zone.

children.title: ToyRecommendations
children.summary: Age-based toy suggestions grouped by category.

children.title: FinancialPlanning
children.summary: Two models in one feature: monthly budgets and savings goals for the family.

children.title: Users + Auth
children.summary: Accounts, profile edits, password change, JWT issue and refresh tokens.

children.title: CurrentUserService
children.summary: Pulls the user id from the JWT claims so services never trust a user id from the request body.

children.title: Domain engines
children.summary: The parts with real logic beyond CRUD: recurring reminders, time zones, growth math and activity picks.

children.title: Recurring reminder engine
children.summary: Works out the next run of a DAILY, WEEKLY or MONTHLY reminder in the parent's own time zone.
children.detail: Steps the calendar in local time, not UTC, so a 7pm bedtime reminder stays at 7pm across DST changes and month lengths. Bad time zone ids fall back to UTC.

children.title: Mark complete
children.summary: SetCompletedAsync checks ownership, flags the reminder done and stamps LastRunAt in UTC.

children.title: Convert to local clock
children.summary: Converts the UTC instant into the reminder's IANA time zone.

children.title: Step the period
children.summary: Adds 1 day, 7 days or 1 month on the local clock based on the RepeatRule enum.

children.title: Back to UTC
children.summary: Converts the local next time back to UTC and saves it as NextRunAt.

children.title: TimeZoneService
children.summary: Shared helper to validate time zone ids and convert between UTC and local; DB always stores UTC.
children.detail: Frontend sends the browser's time zone and shows a timezone indicator so times read right for the parent.

children.title: WHO growth charts
children.summary: Plots a child's height and weight against WHO 3rd, 50th and 97th percentile curves by sex, 0 to 36+ months.
children.detail: Uses a simplified table of WHO percentile values per month (code notes full LMS data as the next step). Metric or imperial with cm-to-inch and kg-to-lb conversion, plus a plain-English guide to reading percentiles.

children.title: Activity suggestion engine
children.summary: Scores age-appropriate activities using today's check-ins, last week's history and time of day, then picks 2-3.
children.detail: Rule-based scoring from a baseline of 50: a rough night boosts calm sensory and fine-motor play and lowers gross-motor. Final picks keep categories varied. No ML model.

children.title: ThriveKid.Data
children.summary: Infrastructure layer: EF Core DbContext, Fluent API configs, migrations and storage service implementations.

children.title: SQLite database
children.summary: Single SQLite file; on Azure it lives on the App Service persistent storage.

children.title: Fluent API configurations
children.summary: One IEntityTypeConfiguration per entity for keys, lengths, relations and indexes.

children.title: EF Core migrations
children.summary: Schema history from the first init through users, time zones, refresh tokens and medical records.
children.detail: Migrations run on every startup. Later ones add UserId to all entities, refresh token indexes, and move medical records from in-memory to real tables.

children.title: Storage services
children.summary: EF Core implementations of each feature's storage interface, so App never touches the DbContext.
children.detail: Renamed from Repository to StorageService during the architecture review for one consistent pattern.

children.title: Dev-only seeder
children.summary: Migrates on startup and seeds demo data only in Development, never a known-login account in prod.

children.title: Auth and security
children.summary: JWT auth with rotating refresh tokens, rate limits, security headers and a 13-fix hardening pass.

children.title: Token flow
children.summary: Short-lived access tokens plus single-use refresh tokens, refreshed quietly by the frontend.

children.title: Register / login
children.summary: BCrypt-hashed passwords; email lowercased; login rate limited to 5 tries per IP per minute.

children.title: 1-hour access JWT
children.summary: HMAC-SHA256 JWT with issuer, audience and a unique jti, cut from 7 days to 1 hour.

children.title: 7-day refresh token
children.summary: 64 random bytes stored server side with expiry and revoked-at, indexed for lookup.

children.title: Silent refresh on 401
children.summary: Axios interceptor catches a 401, calls /auth/refresh once and replays queued requests.
children.detail: An isRefreshing flag plus a queue stops parallel requests from firing duplicate refreshes. If refresh fails, tokens are cleared and the user goes to login.

children.title: Rotate on use
children.summary: Each refresh revokes the old token and issues a fresh pair, so a stolen token works at most once.

children.title: Logout revokes
children.summary: POST /auth/logout revokes the refresh token server side.

children.title: 13-fix security audit
children.summary: Two-phase hardening: 6 critical/high fixes, then 7 more. All 13 marked done.
children.detail: Phase 1: missing [Authorize] on check-in and upload controllers, a hardcoded user id, upload path traversal, user-id-0 fallback, error messages leaking host info, no security headers. Phase 2: 8-char passwords, HSTS, CORS, MaxLength on DTOs, magic bytes, rate limits, refresh tokens.

children.title: Security headers + HSTS
children.summary: nosniff, DENY framing, strict referrer, locked-down permissions policy, and HSTS set by hand behind Azure's TLS.

children.title: Tight CORS
children.summary: Prod allows only configured origins; dev allows localhost and true RFC 1918 LAN ranges.
children.detail: A custom check for 172.16-31.x fixed an earlier rule that let any 172.* origin through.

children.title: Secrets out of git
children.summary: JWT key lives in a git-ignored local file or an env var; the app refuses to start without it.

children.title: Per-user data ownership
children.summary: Every service checks the record's UserId against the JWT user and throws if they don't match.

children.title: Reviews, tests and CI
children.summary: Senior-style code and architecture reviews worked through by severity, unit tests, and CI on every push.

children.title: Code review: 24 fixes
children.summary: Full-stack review fixed critical to low: JWT secret moved out of git, PasswordHash kept out of responses, no logout revocation and more.
children.detail: Worked strictly in severity order (3 critical, 6 high, 9 medium, 6 low), each fix explained before it went in. Ended with 0 TypeScript and 0 C# build errors.

children.title: Architecture review: 8 fixes
children.summary: Fixed DIP/OCP issues, unified naming, added response DTOs, pulled out DI and seeding, cut a double DB trip.
children.detail: Modular-monolith steps like per-module DbContext and domain events were written down as future work, not forced in.

children.title: Production readiness reviews
children.summary: Deployment, frontend responsive, routing and production audits that drove the medical-records and token-index fixes.

children.title: xUnit unit tests
children.summary: Tests for child age math, ownership checks, UTC conversion and password change.
children.detail: Moq fakes the storage and current-user services; FluentAssertions for readable checks. A theory covers age-in-months edge cases.

children.title: GitHub Actions CI
children.summary: Two jobs on push and PR to main: .NET restore/build/test/publish and Node npm ci + build.
children.detail: Frontend build runs tsc -b before vite build, so type errors fail CI. 76 TypeScript build errors were fixed to get it green.

children.title: Smoke scripts
children.summary: Shell scripts that hit health and CRUD endpoints to sanity-check a running API.

children.title: Deploy and ops
children.summary: Frontend on Vercel, API in a Docker image on Azure App Service, telemetry in Application Insights.

children.title: Docker multi-stage build
children.summary: SDK stage restores and publishes; slim aspnet runtime stage serves on port 8080.
children.detail: Copies only the three .csproj files first so the restore layer caches between builds.

children.title: Azure App Service
children.summary: Runs the API; uploads served from /home/uploads so they survive redeploys.

children.title: Vercel frontend
children.summary: Hosts the Vite build with an SPA rewrite so deep links load index.html; API URL from an env var.

children.title: App Insights + request logs
children.summary: Application Insights telemetry plus HTTP logs of method, path, status and duration.

children.title: Build guides + prep agent
children.summary: Step-by-step build guides for every backend and UI feature, plus a GitHub Copilot agent for interview drills.

children.title: Roadmap
children.summary: Planned work written up in the repo's feature docs and reviews.

children.title: Email password reset
children.summary: Reset tokens, email sending and a reset page; designed, marked high priority.

children.title: Web Push notifications
children.summary: VAPID keys, stored subscriptions and server-sent push so reminders arrive with the app closed.

children.title: Offline data sync
children.summary: Background sync to send logs made offline once the connection is back; handler stubbed in the service worker.

children.title: Move off SQLite
children.summary: Review recommends Azure SQL or PostgreSQL for automated backups and safer prod storage.

children.title: Search and filters
children.summary: Search children and filter logs by child, date range and status.
